overloadMerges.note: Output parameters are documented and arrow-marked ('←') as values filled in by the command, not inputs, even though the draft parser defaulted every parameter to direction:in based on syntax position alone; discriminatedBy/semanticRole also added to distinguish this overload from its Variable-addressed sibling.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box via an object-name string (leading '*' passed).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Fills hierarchical (and optionally hierarchy) with whether the list box is in hierarchical mode and its hierarchy pointers, addressed as an object-name string (via the leading '*' flag).

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box via a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Fills hierarchical (and optionally hierarchy) with whether the list box is in hierarchical mode and its hierarchy pointers, addressed as a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').
